score_convention: Higher is more similar; only cosine methods are cosine scores

methods.cosine: Dot product of unit artist vectors
methods.euclidean: Negative Euclidean distance of the same unit vectors
methods.angular: Negative arccos of cosine, in radians
methods.manhattan: Negative sum of absolute coordinate differences
methods.centered_cosine: Subtract sample mean from each artist vector, renormalize, then cosine
methods.local_scaling_k5: exp(-d(i,j)^2 / (sigma(i)*sigma(j))); Euclidean d, sigma = fifth non-self neighbor distance

limitations: Exploratory comparison on the same small sample, not a held-out model selection benchmark.
Review labels are subjective and description-based, not independent listening judgments.
Centering and local scaling depend on the artist cohort and are not plain metric substitutions.
No parameter search; k=5 fixed to match the existing top-five neighborhood size.
Alternating-window stability is within-recording stability, not across-song generalization.
No production changes or recommendation threshold calibration.
